June 16, 2018 - By John Mackenzie
Capital Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Allstate Corporation (ALL) by 46.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Investment Advisors Llc sold 3,616 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,123 shares of the property-casualty insurers company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $391,000, down from 7,739 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Allstate Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $32.97 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.09% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $93.81. About 4.04 million shares traded or 106.83% up from the average.
